visual.alt: Site plan of the Halstock recycling centre. Labelled: the main entrance (Ferry Lane), entrance barrier, internal road, toilets and water point, car park, the reuse shop in a single-storey long building, four garden waste bays, wood and rubble skips, the paint and chemicals store, general waste bins, glass/can/plastic banks, the exit barrier, and a north arrow; five locations numbered 16-20 are left unlabelled. The upward direction of the ramp is shown with arrows.

items.evidence: Immediately on your left is the site office
items.explanation: Immediately on the left after passing through the entrance barrier on Ferry Lane is the green cabin, which is the site office; the toilets and water point are labelled behind it on the plan.

items.evidence: the textiles bank stands at the near end of that same building
items.explanation: The reuse shop is in the single-storey long building next to the car park; the textiles bank is at the near end of the same building, that is, in the section of the plan to the south of the shop.

items.evidence: the left-hand side takes you up the ramp
items.explanation: Beyond the garden waste bays, the road splits in two; the left branch goes up, onto the ramp. This is the narrow passage in the plan whose upward direction is shown with arrows.

items.evidence: Along the right-hand side of the ramp are the skips for wood, rubble and scrap metal
items.explanation: The skips on the right side of the ramp are in the order wood, rubble, scrap metal going upward; since the first two are already labelled on the plan, the topmost one is the scrap metal skip.

items.evidence: The electrical store is opposite the reuse shop
items.explanation: Anything with a plug or a battery goes to the electrical store; this store is directly opposite the reuse shop, on the west side of the road.
